C0133.title: Illegal Game Token Recharge Ring Involving 14 Billion Yuan Busted
C0133.summary: Shanghai police dismantled a gang using online game tokens for illegal currency exchange. Led by a suspect surnamed Shi, the group set up overseas servers and an underground exchange platform. They provided foreign exchange services by recycling and recharging various online game tokens, charging a 5% to 15% fee. The total transaction volume reached 14 billion yuan.
